home.what: the code that lists the studies
home.code:
import asteroidea

asteroidea.sign_in()

studies = asteroidea.studies().to_pandas()
studies[["study", "dataset", "role", "tier", "title"]]

study.what: the code that reads this study's participants and subject links
study.code:
import asteroidea

asteroidea.sign_in()

participants = asteroidea.participants(study={study}).to_pandas()
links = asteroidea.links(study={study}).to_pandas()
links

participant.what: the code that reads this participant's subject links

session.what: the code that reads this session's stored summary and units
session.code:
import asteroidea

asteroidea.sign_in()

summary = asteroidea.session_summary({dataset}, {subject}, {session})
if summary is None:
    msg = "No stored summary for this session yet."
    raise LookupError(msg)
units = summary.units.to_pandas()
units[["unit_index", "location", "spike_count", "mean_rate_hz"]]
